problem: The pricing responsive/i18n fix was merged to protected main, but Netlify production remained on an older deploy and therefore did not contain the merged candidate.
root_cause: The normal main merge did not trigger a Netlify production deployment. The repository's canonical exact-source transport is Production Source Snapshot, but that workflow only auto-runs on a main push that changes its own workflow file.
prevention: Treat GitHub merge and Netlify production identity as separate gates.
When production commit_ref differs from protected main, trigger the canonical Production Source Snapshot workflow rather than claiming the release live.
Require release.json commit_ref and production context to match the exact protected-main SHA.
Require public pricing content/readback before terminal closure.
